WITH strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ha.hero_id
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Super Strength'
),
power_owners AS (
  SELECT hp.power_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT hp.hero_id) AS total_owners,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sh.hero_id IS NOT NULL THEN hp.hero_id END) AS strength_owners
  FROM hero_power hp
  LEFT JOIN strength_heroes sh ON sh.hero_id = hp.hero_id
  GROUP BY hp.power_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS power_count
FROM power_owners
WHERE strength_owners > 0
  AND strength_owners = total_owners;

  GROUP BY hp.power_id
)

WITH eligible AS (

    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
    JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'blue'

FROM eligible AS e
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = e.gender_id
WHERE LOWER(g.gender) IN ('male', 'female')
GROUP BY g.gender
ORDER BY g.gender;

WITH cryo_holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
  WHERE LOWER(sp.power_name) = 'cryokinesis'

related_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  WHERE hp.power_id IN (
    SELECT hp2.power_id
    FROM hero_power hp2
    WHERE hp2.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM cryo_holders)
  )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1) AS avg_superpowers
FROM (
  SELECT rh.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM related_heroes rh
  JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = rh.hero_id
  GROUP BY rh.hero_id
);

For my cryokinesis page, I want to know how broad the power portfolios are around ice-powered heroes. Consider all heroes who share at least one superpower with a cryokinesis holder - including the cryokinesis holders themselves, since they share cryokinesis with each other. What is the average number of superpowers these heroes have, rounded to one decimal place? Please send back just that single number.

arguments.sql:
WITH cryo_holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
  WHERE LOWER(sp.power_name) = 'cryokinesis'
), related_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  WHERE hp.power_id IN (
    SELECT hp2.power_id
    FROM hero_power hp2
    WHERE hp2.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM cryo_holders)
  )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1) AS avg_superpowers
FROM (
  SELECT rh.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM related_heroes rh
  JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = rh.hero_id
  GROUP BY rh.hero_id
)

I'm researching heroes like A-Bomb. What is the average height in centimetres of the superheroes in A-Bomb's group? Please give me just that single number, rounded to one decimal place. Note that A-Bomb itself belongs to its group and should be included, and only heroes whose height is actually on record should count toward the average-anyone without a recorded height should be left out rather than counted as some height.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

arguments.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(height_cm AS REAL)), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero
WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND id IN (
    SELECT ha.hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha
    JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Group Affiliation'
      AND ha.attribute_value IN (
        SELECT ha2.attribute_value
        FROM superhero AS s2
        JOIN hero_attribute AS ha2 ON ha2.hero_id = s2.id
        JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
        WHERE s2.superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
          AND a2.attribute_name = 'Group Affiliation'
      )
  )
SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id=s.id JOIN attribute a ON a.id=ha.attribute_id WHERE s.superhero_name='A-Bomb'
SELECT id, superhero_name, full_name, height_cm FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name LIKE '%A-Bomb%' OR full_name LIKE '%A-Bomb%'

SELECT a.attribute_name, COUNT(*) AS n, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ha.attribute_value) AS values_seen FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON a.id=ha.attribute_id GROUP BY a.attribute_name ORDER BY a.attribute_name

WHERE race_rank = 1
ORDER BY race;

sql:
WITH hero_counts AS (
    SELECT
        g.gender,
        h.id,
        COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS h
    JOIN gender AS g
        ON g.id = h.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp
        ON hp.hero_id = h.id
    WHERE h.full_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(h.full_name) <> ''
      AND LOWER(g.gender) IN ('male', 'female')
    GROUP BY g.gender, h.id
)
SELECT
    gender,
    ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS average_superpowers_per_hero
FROM hero_counts
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY CASE LOWER(gender)
    WHEN 'male' THEN 1
    WHEN 'female' THEN 2
END;

FROM superhero AS hero
JOIN colour AS eye_colour
  ON eye_colour.id = hero.eye_colour_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM superhero AS brown_haired

    ON hair_colour.id = brown_haired.hair_colour_id
  WHERE brown_haired.eye_colour_id = hero.eye_colour_id
    AND LOWER(hair_colour.colour) = 'brown'
)
AND (
  hero.hair_colour_id IS NULL
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM colour AS hair_colour
    WHERE hair_colour.id = hero.hair_colour_id
      AND LOWER(hair_colour.colour) = 'brown'
  )
)
GROUP BY eye_colour.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour.colour ASC;

WITH parsed AS (

    l.ID,

),
strongest AS (
  SELECT MAX(rnp_value) AS max_rnp
  FROM parsed
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM parsed
  WHERE rnp_value = (SELECT max_rnp FROM strongest)
),
highest_bilirubin AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_bilirubin) AS max_bilirubin
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT
  c.total_bilirubin,
  c.Date AS lab_test_date,
  c.ID AS patient_id,
  c.SEX,
  c.Birthday
FROM candidates AS c
WHERE c.total_bilirubin = (SELECT max_bilirubin FROM highest_bilirubin);

WITH thrombosis_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
    AND p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
)

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  WHERE l.ID = tp.ID
    AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
    AND LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) <> 'negative'
    AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
);

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE p.Admission = '+'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS l
          WHERE l.ID = p.ID
            AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
            AND TRIM(l.SSA) <> ''
            AND UPPER(TRIM(l.SSA)) NOT IN ('-', 'NEG', 'NEGATIVE', 'NORMAL', '0')
      )
),
titers AS (
    SELECT e.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS anti_RNP_titer
    FROM eligible AS e
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = e.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.ID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT ID, anti_RNP_titer,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY anti_RNP_titer DESC) AS rnk
    FROM titers
)
SELECT ID, anti_RNP_titer
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1;

sql:
WITH NeverExamined AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Examination AS e
          WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      )
),
LabDateCounts AS (
    SELECT n.ID, n.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT l.Date) AS test_date_count
    FROM NeverExamined AS n
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = n.ID
    GROUP BY n.ID, n.SEX
)
SELECT SEX, ROUND(AVG(test_date_count), 2) AS average_laboratory_test_dates
FROM LabDateCounts
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

Among the laboratory records of female patients diagnosed with systemic lupus erythematosus at an examination visit, where total protein is above the normal bound of 8.5, what is the average deviation of total protein from that bound across all qualifying records, rounded to three decimal places? I'm preparing a department audit on how often anti-ribonuclear protein testing comes back clearly elevated among the women in the thrombosis cohort. Among the women in the cohort, what percentage of those with an available anti-ribonuclear protein test result had a clearly elevated result? Please give me the percentage rounded to two decimal places on the 0-100 scale. Note: elevated means a titer strictly above 1:64. Patients never tested for anti-ribonuclear protein should be excluded from both the numerator and the denominator, while a negative reading counts as an available result and is never elevated.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

arguments.sql:
WITH women_in_thrombosis_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE lower(trim(p.SEX)) IN ('f', 'female', 'woman', 'women')
    AND e.Thrombosis = 1
), rnp_results AS (
  SELECT w.ID, l.RNP
  FROM women_in_thrombosis_cohort w
  JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = w.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL AND trim(l.RNP) <> ''
), classified AS (
  SELECT ID, RNP,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(trim(RNP)) IN ('negative', 'neg', '-') THEN 0
      WHEN trim(RNP) LIKE '%>%' AND CAST(substr(trim(RNP), instr(trim(RNP), '>') + 1) AS REAL) > 64 THEN 1
      WHEN trim(RNP) LIKE '%:%' AND CAST(substr(trim(RNP), instr(trim(RNP), ':') + 1) AS REAL) > 64 THEN 1
      WHEN CAST(trim(RNP) AS REAL) > 64 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS elevated
  FROM rnp_results
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(elevated) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS percentage_elevated
FROM classified;

sql:
WITH psoriatic_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
),
per_patient AS (
  SELECT p.ID, COUNT(l.ID) AS lab_count
  FROM psoriatic_patients AS p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(lab_count), 0) AS total_laboratory_tests,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lab_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests
FROM per_patient;

For the patients in the registry with a diagnosis of psoriatic arthritis, I'd like to know: (1) the total number of laboratory tests recorded for these patients, counting tests from all dates, and (2) how many of these patients have no laboratory tests recorded at all (i.e., patients with no laboratory record count as having no laboratory tests).

arguments.sql:
WITH psoriatic_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
), per_patient AS (
  SELECT p.ID, COUNT(l.ID) AS lab_count
  FROM psoriatic_patients p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID

  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lab_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests
FROM per_patient;

WITH sle_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%SLE%'
),
thrombotic_episodes AS (
  SELECT e.Symptoms
  FROM Examination AS e
  JOIN sle_patients AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
  WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
),
symptom_counts AS (
  SELECT TRIM(j.value) AS symptom, COUNT(*) AS episode_count
  FROM thrombotic_episodes AS t,
       json_each(
         '[' || '"' ||
         REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(t.Symptoms, ''), '"', '\\"'), ',', '","') ||
         '"' || ']'
       ) AS j
  WHERE TRIM(j.value) <> ''
  GROUP BY TRIM(j.value)
)
SELECT symptom
FROM symptom_counts
ORDER BY episode_count DESC, symptom COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

)
SELECT symptom

I'm reviewing renal function in the thrombosis cohort and want to compare how often creatinine runs out of the normal range between men and women. For each sex (M and F), please give me: the number of patients of that sex with at least one creatinine result out of the normal range, the total number of patients of that sex, and the share those patients represent of that sex's total as a percentage rounded to one decimal place. Rules: out of the normal range means a creatinine result of 1.5 or higher; the total per sex counts every patient of that sex on file whether or not any lab result exists for them.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

arguments.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Examination AS e
        WHERE e.ID = p.ID
          AND e.Thrombosis = 1
    )
),
sex_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.SEX,
        COUNT(*) AS total_patients,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Laboratory AS l
            WHERE l.ID = c.ID
              AND l.CRE >= 1.5
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_high_creatinine
    FROM cohort AS c
    WHERE c.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
    GROUP BY c.SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    patients_with_high_creatinine,
    total_patients,
    ROUND(100.0 * patients_with_high_creatinine / total_patients, 1) AS percentage
FROM sex_counts
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, l.RNP AS rnp_level
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p."First Date") AS INTEGER) = 1991
    AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
),
top_level AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp_level AS REAL)) AS max_level
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id, e.rnp_level
FROM eligible e
CROSS JOIN top_level t
WHERE CAST(e.rnp_level AS REAL) = t.max_level
ORDER BY e.patient_id;

I'm putting together a care-setting summary of severe SLE cases for the rheumatology department. Among patients diagnosed with SLE, considering only those whose only diagnosis is SLE and who had abnormally high proteinuria, how many were admitted to the hospital and how many were followed at the outpatient clinic? Please count each patient based on their full history at the hospital.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

arguments.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.Admission
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(p.Diagnosis)) = 'SLE'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory l
          WHERE l.ID = p.ID
            AND LOWER(TRIM(l."U-PRO")) IN ('+++', '++++')
      )
)
SELECT Admission AS care_setting, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM eligible
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY Admission;
SELECT DISTINCT Diagnosis FROM Patient ORDER BY Diagnosis;
SELECT DISTINCT Admission FROM Patient ORDER BY Admission;
SELECT DISTINCT "U-PRO" FROM Laboratory ORDER BY "U-PRO";

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.Admission
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(p.Diagnosis)) = 'SLE'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory l
          WHERE l.ID = p.ID
            AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')
      )
)
SELECT CASE
           WHEN TRIM(Admission) = '+' THEN 'Hospital admission'
           WHEN TRIM(Admission) = '-' THEN 'Outpatient clinic'
           ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(Admission), ''), 'Unknown')
       END AS care_setting,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM eligible
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;
SELECT p.Admission, COUNT(*) AS patients FROM Patient p WHERE UPPER(TRIM(p.Diagnosis))='SLE' GROUP BY p.Admission;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.Admission,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID=p.ID AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") IN ('3','4','300','>=300','>=1000')) AS high_proteinuria
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
    AND UPPER(TRIM(p.Diagnosis)) LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND UPPER(TRIM(p.Diagnosis)) NOT LIKE '%SUSP%'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(Admission)='+' THEN 'Hospital admission'
            WHEN TRIM(Admission)='-' THEN 'Outpatient clinic'
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(Admission),''),'Unknown') END AS care_setting,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM candidates
WHERE high_proteinuria
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID

)

FROM Patient p

JOIN latest_scl70 s ON s.ID = p.ID
WHERE ls.latest_date > '1997-01-01'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(s.result)) = 'normal';

WITH severe_anemia AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB < 8.0
)
SELECT CASE
         WHEN LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('f', 'female') THEN 'female'
         WHEN LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('m', 'male') THEN 'male'
       END AS sex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN severe_anemia AS s ON s.ID = p.ID
WHERE LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('f', 'female', 'm', 'male')
GROUP BY CASE
           WHEN LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('f', 'female') THEN 'female'
           WHEN LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('m', 'male') THEN 'male'
         END
ORDER BY sex;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS patients_with_lab_result,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL
        AND l."T-BIL" > 1.2
    ) THEN p.ID
  END) AS patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin
FROM Patient p
WHERE (p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
  );

I'm screening outpatient clinic patients with anemia for rheumatologic autoimmunity. Among patients who were followed as outpatients (rather than admitted to the hospital) and who ever had a hemoglobin value below 10 on any lab test, who showed the strongest anti-ribonuclear protein antibody response? Please return, for every patient whose anti-ribonuclear protein antibody level reached the highest point ever recorded on their lab tests (list all of them if several share that highest level): the patient ID, the patient's sex, and that highest-ever recorded anti-ribonuclear protein antibody level. Nothing else.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

arguments.sql:
WITH outpatient_anemic AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(p.Admission, '')) LIKE '%outpatient%'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.HGB < 10
    )
), rnp_values AS (
  SELECT o.ID, o.SEX,
         MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_rnp
  FROM outpatient_anemic o
  JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = o.ID
  WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(l.RNP, '')) <> ''
    AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.ID, o.SEX
), max_level AS (
  SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS level FROM rnp_values
)
SELECT r.ID AS patient_id, r.SEX AS sex, r.highest_rnp AS highest_ever_rnp_antibody_level
FROM rnp_values r
JOIN max_level m ON r.highest_rnp = m.level
ORDER BY r.ID;

WITH outpatient_anemic AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p.Admission, ''))) IN ('outpatient', 'out patient', 'no', '0')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.HGB < 10)
), rnp_values AS (
  SELECT o.ID, o.SEX, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_rnp
  FROM outpatient_anemic o
  JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = o.ID
  WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.ID, o.SEX
)

WITH ranked_labs AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID,
    l.GOT,
    l.RNP,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory AS l
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM ranked_labs AS r
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = r.ID
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND r.GOT < 60
  AND CAST(r.RNP AS REAL) > 10;

ORDER BY n.max_gpt DESC, p.ID ASC

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID,
    l.Date AS test_date,
    l.DNA AS level,
    p.Diagnosis,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age_years,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, l.Date ASC, l.ID ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.Admission = '+'
    AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ID, test_date, level, age_years, Diagnosis
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH lupus_results AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.Diagnosis AS diagnosis,
    l.DNA AS anti_dna_result,
    CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) AS numeric_result
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE (p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%lupus%')
    AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(numeric_result) OVER () AS max_result
  FROM lupus_results
)
SELECT
  patient_id,
  diagnosis,
  anti_dna_result AS highest_anti_dna_result
FROM ranked
WHERE numeric_result = max_result;

  SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.Diagnosis AS diagnosis, l.DNA AS anti_dna_result,
         CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) AS numeric_result
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE (p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%lupus%')
    AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, MAX(numeric_result) OVER () AS max_result
  FROM lupus_results
)
SELECT patient_id, diagnosis, anti_dna_result AS highest_anti_dna_result
FROM ranked
WHERE numeric_result = max_result

WITH latest_igg AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    IGG,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
),
setting_patients AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    CASE
      WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
      WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS setting
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
  setting AS label,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.IGG BETWEEN 700 AND 1600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
  ) AS percentage
FROM setting_patients AS p
LEFT JOIN latest_igg AS l
  ON l.ID = p.ID AND l.rn = 1
GROUP BY setting
ORDER BY CASE setting
  WHEN 'admitted to the hospital' THEN 1
  ELSE 2
END;

WITH confirmed AS (
  SELECT ID, Admission
  FROM Patient
  WHERE UPPER(Diagnosis) LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND UPPER(Diagnosis) NOT LIKE '%SUSP%'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission IN ('+', '-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS either_setting
  FROM confirmed
)
SELECT
  inpatients,
  outpatient,
  ROUND(100.0 * inpatients / NULLIF(either_setting, 0), 2) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM counts;

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID AS patient_id,
        p.Birthday,
        p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis,
        e."Examination Date" AS examination_date,
        e.Symptoms AS symptom,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC, p.ID ASC, e."Examination Date" DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
      AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
)
SELECT patient_id, Birthday, symptom, overall_diagnosis
FROM qualifying
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH patient_alt AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    MAX(CASE WHEN l.GPT > 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_abnormal_alt
  FROM Patient AS p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT
  CASE SEX
    WHEN 'M' THEN 'male'
    WHEN 'F' THEN 'female'
  END AS sex,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM patient_alt
WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  AND COALESCE(has_abnormal_alt, 0) = 0
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH rbc_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RBC < 3.5
),
patient_ages AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.Admission AS care_setting,
    CASE
      WHEN p.Birthday IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 AS INTEGER)
        - CASE
            WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
    END AS completed_age
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN rbc_patients AS r ON r.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
  care_setting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count,
  ROUND(AVG(completed_age), 1) AS average_completed_age
FROM patient_ages
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY CASE care_setting WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bond
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
most_common AS (
  SELECT bond_type
  FROM bond_counts
  ORDER BY cnt DESC, bond_type
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common) AS bond_type,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(m.label) = 'carcinogenic' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR010';

sql:
WITH bond_status AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(bs.bond_count, 0) > 0
       AND bs.bond_count = bs.single_bond_count
      THEN 'every_bond_single'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS bond_group
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond_status AS bs ON bs.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  bond_group,
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM classified
GROUP BY bond_group
ORDER BY CASE bond_group WHEN 'every_bond_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

arguments.sql:
WITH bond_status AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
), classified AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         m.label,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs.bond_count, 0) > 0
                   AND bs.bond_count = bs.single_bond_count
              THEN 'every_bond_single'
              ELSE 'other'
         END AS bond_group
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN bond_status bs ON bs.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT bond_group,
       SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM classified
GROUP BY bond_group
ORDER BY CASE bond_group WHEN 'every_bond_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

FROM molecule AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND UPPER(a.element) = 'N'
)

    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN connected AS c
      ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id

     AND b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND UPPER(a.element) = 'N'
      AND UPPER(b.bond_type) IN ('DOUBLE', 'TRIPLE')
);

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE LOWER(bond_type) IN ('triple', 'triple bond')
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN triple_bond_molecules AS t
    ON t.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE LOWER(m.label) IN ('carcinogenic', 'non-carcinogenic')
  GROUP BY m.label
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(molecule_count) AS total_count
  FROM counts
)
SELECT
  counts.label,
  ROUND(100.0 * counts.molecule_count / total.total_count, 2) AS percent
FROM counts
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY CASE LOWER(counts.label)
  WHEN 'carcinogenic' THEN 1
  WHEN 'non-carcinogenic' THEN 2
END;

    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY element

    SELECT element
    FROM element_molecule_counts
    WHERE molecule_count = 1

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(element) = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(element) = 'CL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN UPPER(b.bond_type) IN ('DOUBLE', 'TRIPLE', 'AROMATIC') THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS multiple_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM connected c
            JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
            WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id
              AND a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
              AND UPPER(a.element) = 'C'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_touching_bonds
    FROM bond b
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC,
                 COALESCE(ac.number_of_atoms, 0) DESC,
                 m.molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank,
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
    COALESCE(ac.number_of_atoms, 0) AS number_of_atoms,

    COALESCE(ac.carbon_atoms, 0) AS carbon_atoms,
    COALESCE(ac.chlorine_atoms, 0) AS chlorine_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
    COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom_counts ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(element) = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(element) = 'CL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),

        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(b.bond_type) IN ('DOUBLE', 'TRIPLE', 'AROMATIC') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds,

        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_touching_bonds
    FROM bond b
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)

FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id AND c.atom_id < c.atom_id2
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id

WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')

GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;

  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
  FROM bond
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND bond_type IN ('-', '=')

  SELECT DISTINCT
         b.bond_type,
         CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS element1,
         CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS element2
  FROM bond AS b
  JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')

WITH atom_bond_profile AS (
    SELECT
        a.atom_id,
        a.element,
        COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN b.bond_type IS NOT NULL AND b.bond_type <> 'single' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS non_single_bond_count
    FROM atom AS a
    LEFT JOIN connected AS c
        ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    LEFT JOIN bond AS b
        ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT
    element,
    COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom_bond_profile
WHERE bond_count > 0
  AND non_single_bond_count = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;
